contract: The whole-parent identity certificate additionally admits only exact common linear translation of each triangle: all three vertex displacement vectors must be exactly equal as dyadic FP32 endpoint differences. Difference equality is checked with an error-free two-float expansion, not rounded FP32 subtraction. A common translation leaves the triangle shape invariant for the complete linear sweep, preventing an endpoint-nondegenerate parent from collapsing in between.
